title: Charge for Holding the Bench Open Out of Hours
content:
# Bench Standing Order: Holding the Bench Open Out of Hours

## When the bench is held open

The bench is held open out of hours to finish ahead of the queue a piece whose time since the customer authorised the work has run past the level's target turnaround or that a check has sent back to the bench, and the charge for holding it open is decided on those two records alone.

Where the time since the customer authorised the work is compared with the level's target turnaround of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service, that target turnaround is counted in calendar days, taking 7 calendar days to 5 working days.

## What is charged

| Time since the work was authorised has run past the level's target turnaround | A check that found rework needed stands on the order | The charge for holding the bench open |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the level's own out-of-hours charge in full, 100 percent of it |
| yes | no | that charge at the part share, 50 percent of it |
| no | yes | that charge at the part share, 50 percent of it |
| no | no | nothing is charged on these grounds |

**In words.** Where the time since the customer authorised the work has run past the level's target turnaround and a check stands on the work order that found rework needed, the charge for holding the bench open out of hours is the level's own out-of-hours charge in full, 100 percent of it; where exactly one of those two holds, it is that charge at the part share, 50 percent of it. In any other case nothing is charged on these grounds.

## Worked on hypothetical inputs

At a level whose target turnaround is 7 business days and whose out-of-hours charge is 125.00 USD, that target counted in calendar days comes to 9.8 calendar days. A piece authorised 15 calendar days ago with a check that found rework needed standing on the order carries the charge in full, 125.00 USD. The same piece with no such check carries it at the part share, 62.50 USD. A piece authorised 4 calendar days ago with such a check standing carries 62.50 USD; with no such check, nothing is charged on these grounds.
